page.overview:
Who is Antonio Marcelli III?

Antonio Marcelli III was a descendant of Meldo Marcelli and the Prince of Tobaro until his death in 1877 IC, bringing the end of House Marcelli's rule over the city-state.

Antonio Marcelli III was the last of the Marcelli family to rule Tobaro as Prince. The family had ruled Tobaro as for centuries ever since Meldo Marcelli saved the city from a Skaven invasion, their reign often looked back upon as the golden years of Tobaran culture. Antonio's death, however, led to a succesion squable that threatened civil war. Conflict was only averted when the court seer prophesied the next prince would meet with an unpleasant fate. The crisis of secession was turned on its head, as suddenly no one wanted the post. Instead, in an attempt to ward off the prophecy, a pig was chosen as prince.

Years passed and under the benevolent reign of "Piggalo" Tobaro enjoyed peace, free from the machinations and manoeuvrings of the Marcellis, who returned to what they did best: trade. A new human Prince was elected after the pig died by falling off a cliff after 12 years of "rule", but the Marcellis didn't return to power.
